title: Blood-Ion-Repeat Verification Receipt v1
description: Receipt schema for multi-trial blood-ion-repeat experiment verification. Includes trial-wise results (trial_count, trials_passed, trials_failed) alongside aggregated outcomes.

experiment_id.description: Identifier for the experiment run, matching the config experiment_id.

result.description: Aggregate result: PASS only when all trials pass.

trial_count.description: Total number of trials observed in the trace.

trials_passed.description: Number of trials that passed (zero symbol errors and CRC match).

total_symbol_errors.description: Total symbol decode errors across all trials.

aggregate_ber.description: Aggregate bit error rate: total_symbol_errors / total_symbols.

crc_pass_rate.description: Fraction of trials where CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE matched.

sha256_trace.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical trace (prefixed 'sha256:').

symbol_count.description: Number of symbols in this trial.

symbol_errors.description: Number of symbol decode errors in this trial.

ber.description: Bit error rate for this trial.

crc_pass.description: Whether CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE matched for this trial.

passed.description: Whether this trial passed (zero errors and CRC match).

fail_reason.description: Reason for failure, or empty string if trial passed.
